notes: Window = union of a 250 m disc at the origin and a 120 m disc around every graph node whose kind is in exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in street_floor_ids (street-level node); exit_poi_connectors adds the graph nodes that stations/ikebukuro/gteki/pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of POIs with category exit (x36f, x4f, x13f: exits whose connector is a b1 stair foot, not a street node). graph.json and pois.json are read-only and their sha256 go in the receipt. The window touches third-level meshes 53394576 and 53394577 only (plus 50 m mesh_margin_m for features that straddle a mesh edge; a third mesh, 53394586, first matters at roughly 100-110 m, with or without the stair-foot discs); a missing or unacquired mesh fails the run. Default merge kind = one building mesh and one road mesh. Visual-only context (gteki_role context, NOT_FOR_ROUTING); textures are not converted. Default kinds = both. Roads ship as geometry only under an Owner risk acceptance (docs/gis/decisions/2026-10-22-plateau-tran-geometry-risk-acceptance.md; #39 comment 6323977745): the GSI approval 令7関公第296号 in the tran lineage is treated as attribute-scoped and no tran attribute is shipped; --kinds bldg gives the buildings-only files.
